title: Follow new deals
intro: Keep up with DealScout in your feed reader, or save individual deals to revisit on this device.
feedTitle: Add DealScout to your RSS reader
feedDescription: Copy a feed URL into your reader’s add-feed field. The feed uses the same approved, recently checked catalog as the website. No DealScout account is required.
priceNote: Feed readers can keep older entries. Each entry states when its price was checked; open the deal and confirm the current offer on Amazon before buying.
savedDescription: Tap the heart on a deal to save it, then return to Saved Deals on this device. This is a shortlist to check again, not an email subscription or a promise that a price will stay the same.
